==Background==
{{Quote|That moment is the best treasure in the world.|Author's comment}}
'''Poppin' Candy☆Fever!''' is an original electropop, J-pop song by kinoshita. It was uploaded to Niconico and bilibili on October 29, 2019.

This song has enterend the ''[[Hall of Legend]]'' and exceeded over 10 million YouTube views. Hence, this is one of kinoshita's most notable songs.

==Other media appearances==
===Discography===
This song is featured in the following albums:
*Colorful Story (Una's Version)
*CRAYON ADVENTURE (Una & Rin's Version)
